subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should maintainers approve this expanded redacted log-and-doctor diagnostic boundary after the stale-owner fix and exact-head proof confirm that no SecretRef identity or value reaches operator output?
rationale: The patch changes the operational visibility of secret-resolution failures and carries compatibility and sensitive-diagnostics implications that cannot be accepted solely from implementation review.

options.title: Approve after targeted repair and proof
options.body: Require the source-only owner-inventory repair plus an exact-head redacted runtime transcript before accepting the diagnostic surface.

options.title: Narrow the diagnostic surface
options.body: Retain the existing limited degraded-owner visibility if maintainers do not want the new warning and doctor reason taxonomy exposed.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted repair and proof
recommendation.body: Require the source-only owner-inventory repair plus an exact-head redacted runtime transcript before accepting the diagnostic surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged SecretRef isolation work is the closest established ownership trail for this runtime-state and degradation-reporting contract.
